value.rationale: The result addresses the naturally motivated establishment/extinction boundary for a spatial strong-Allee metapopulation. It gives a sharp opposite-direction effect according to an initially colonized minority versus majority, a nontrivial first-order finite-mixing coefficient, and the failure of mean-and-variance-only risk summaries through an explicit pair of equal-mean/equal-variance but opposite-skewness states. It is a structural classification, not a routine code check or an arbitrary parameter slice; limitations exclude empirical predictions and nonuniform networks.
